exposure: Emergency department visit (with gonorrhea and chlamydia testing)
cohort: The study included 398 sexually active female individuals aged 13-19 years who were tested for gonorrhea and chlamydia in an urban ED between 2004-2006 and were patients in affiliated primary care clinics.
finding: 70.1% of the sexually active teens in this cohort became pregnant within 4 years of being tested for gonorrhea and chlamydia in the ED, with a mean interval to conception of 15.8 months.
